jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
**Product Engineer – AI\-drivet produktteam**

**Om rollen**


Vi söker en Product Engineer till ett produktteam som arbetar enligt ett AI\-assisterat arbetssätt, där stora delar av koden genereras med hjälp av AI\-verktyg.


I takt med att själva implementationsarbetet gått snabbare har fokus flyttats mot att formulera rätt krav, förstå domänen på djupet, bygga tydlig kontext och ge AI:n rätt förutsättningar för att leverera väl fungerande lösningar. I den här rollen blir du en nyckelperson i det arbetet.


Du förenar teknisk kompetens med produkt\- och kravarbete och driver frågor hela vägen från idé till färdig lösning – genom att ställa rätt frågor, strukturera och förbereda underlag, bygga relevant kontext för AI\-verktygen och säkerställa att kraven är tillräckligt tydliga för att omsättas i fungerande kod.


Du behåller samtidigt din tekniska hands\-on\-förmåga och bidrar vid behov med implementation, kodgranskning och testning av AI\-genererad kod. Fördelningen mellan kravarbete och utveckling varierar från uppgift till uppgift.


Rollen passar dig som trivs i skärningspunkten mellan produkt och teknik och som drivs av att vara med och forma nya arbetssätt där AI är en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen. Du samarbetar tätt med produkt, arkitektur och utveckling, och får ett brett ansvar för att driva arbetet framåt – från identifierat behov till levererad funktionalitet.


Arbetet bedrivs i mindre, fokuserade team där du som Product Engineer har en central funktion i att samordna krav, skapa goda förutsättningar för utvecklingsarbetet och säkerställa att lösningen hänger ihop både funktionellt och tekniskt.

**Teknisk miljö**

* Backend: .NET Core
* Frontend: React
* Drift: Microsoft Azure
* Databas: MongoDB (Atlas)
* Miljön är ISO 27001\-certifierad och utvecklas enligt organisationens interna säkerhetsramverk och riktlinjer

**Kvalifikationer**

* Mycket god erfarenhet av Claude eller motsvarande AI\-baserade kodningsverktyg, och en stark förmåga att omsätta domänproblem och krav till tydliga, väl underbyggda prompter som leder till rätt tekniskt resultat
* Gedigen teknisk kompetens och förmåga att själv koda för att granska, felsöka och vid behov skriva eller justera kod
* Förmåga att arbeta nära produktsidan, ställa rätt frågor, strukturera underlag och driva krav framåt utan att invänta färdiga specifikationer

**Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av GDPR/dataskydd och/eller informationssäkerhet är meriterande, eftersom produkten verkar inom detta område och sådan kunskap stärker förmågan att formulera relevanta och välgrundade krav

jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare
jobs.description:
Är du en erfaren .NET\-utvecklare som gillar modern teknik, smarta kollegor och uppdrag där du faktiskt får påverka? Då vill vi gärna prata med dig.
  
Just nu söker vi flera .NET\-utvecklare till våra kommande konsultuppdrag i Stockholm. Skicka gärna in en ansökan om du är på jakt efter ett nytt spännande uppdrag eller bara nyfiken på vad marknaden har att erbjuda, så kikar vi om vi har något inne som kan passa.
  
Om Devoote
  
På Devoote tror vi på nära relationer, tekniskt intressanta uppdrag och en vardag där konsulterna faktiskt känner varandra. Hos oss handlar det inte bara om nästa uppdrag, utan om att bygga långsiktiga relationer med både kunder och konsulter.
  
Oavsett om du är anställd eller underkonsult blir du en del av vårt nätverk med erfarenhetsutbyten, tekniksnack, AW: s, middagar och aktiviteter som vi gör för att det är roligt!
  
Om rollen
  
Som konsult hos Devoote kommer du att arbeta i uppdrag hos våra kunder i Stockholm. Uppdragens innehåll varierar beroende på kund, team och bransch, men du kommer vanligtvis att arbeta med utveckling av moderna affärskritiska system och digitala tjänster.
  
Beroende på uppdrag kan du vara involverad i hela utvecklingsprocessen, från design och arkitektur till implementation, testning och drift. Du kan också komma att arbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter, produktägare och andra intressenter i agila team där kvalitet, innovation och kunskapsdelning står i fokus.
  
Vi arbetar med längre uppdrag hos välkända företag och strävar efter att hitta uppdrag som matchar din kompetens, erfarenhet och dina karriärmål.
  
Vi söker dig som har
  
Minst 5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling i .NET
  
Goda kunskaper i .NET och C\#
  
Erfarenhet av React och TypeScript
  
Erfarenhet av Azure
  
Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
  
  

Personliga egenskaper
  
  

**Vi tror att du:**  

Är lösningsorienterad och nyfiken
  
Tar eget ansvar och driver ditt arbete framåt
  
Trivs med samarbete och kunskapsdelning
  
  

Därför väljer utvecklare Devoote
  
Hos oss får du mer än bara ett nytt uppdrag.
  
Långa uppdrag där du får möjlighet att skapa verkligt värde över tid
  
Frihet att påverka hur du arbetar och vilka lösningar du driver fram
  
Snabba beslut och korta vägar mellan idé och genomförande
  
Möjlighet att arbeta hos några av Sveriges mest välkända företag
  
Regelbundna middagar, aktiviteter och event för den som vill vara med
  
  

Låter det intressant?
  
Oavsett om du är nyfiken på att bli anställd konsult eller driver eget är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig.
  
Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

jobs.title: Senior C#./NET Developer for Interest Rate Service (IRS) solution | SEB, Solna
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about new technology and making a difference? Join our digital transformation!  

  

SEB is more than just a bank with an IT function. We are a tech company powered by innovation and fueled by collaboration. From COBOL to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive tech stack and several technology paths. Together we're innovating and building the tech arena of the future. Are you ready to take on a new challenge? If so, you'll be interested in this opportunity!


**About the role:**



Join the IRS team and help drive one of SEB's strategic account and interest rate services. We are looking for a senior developer who enjoys taking ownership from design and development all the way to production support and operational excellence.



This role is ideal for a senior engineer who wants significant responsibility, technical influence, and direct impact on a business\-critical platform.



As a senior C\# developer, you will play a key role in driving the development and implementation of SEB’s account administration and interest rate services team. You will onboard to a recently developed Interest Rate Service solution with an exciting roadmap that serves as a strategic enabler within the Accounts offering, built in\-house on a standardized technology stack using .NET and Angular. Working as part of an agile team of skilled developers, you will contribute hands\-on to designing, developing, and delivering high\-quality software, while collaborating closely with product owners and stakeholders to define and ship new features. You will work with technologies such as C\#/.NET, PostgreSQL, OpenShift, GitHub Actions, and Angular, participate in technical, architectural, and methodological investigations, and help ensure performance, quality, responsiveness, code quality, organization, and automation across the solution.


**What you'll do**


* Build and evolve business\-critical APIs and services using .NET
* Design robust solutions and drive technical improvements
* Work hands\-on with PostgreSQL, Entity Framework Core, OpenShift, GitHub Actions, and Angular
* Take ownership of production stability, incident resolution, and operational excellence
* Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, and stakeholders to deliver customer value


**We believe you'll thrive if you**


* Are a senior developer with strong C\#/.NET and SQL skills
* Has strong experience with OpenShift and CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, and DevOps practices
* Enjoy taking ownership and solving complex problems independently
* Have experience operating and improving production systems
* Care about code quality, automation, maintainability, and reliability
* Like working in a small team where your contributions make a real difference


**Do you want to be part of SEB?**  

  

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value\-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.



We encourage you to submit your application no later than 28th of September via the link in this advertisement. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Jia Linder at jia.linder@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.  


Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.  

**But where does that take you?**


To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data\-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

**And there’s more.** We are part of the family\-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast\-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

 **Job Description** **We are looking for a**

**Senior Backend Engineer (C\#/.Net) (m/f/d)**

**Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.**

  

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer\-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human\-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product \& tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

 **What you’ll actually be doing**


As part of a cross\-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

* **Build \& scale core services:** Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business\-critical workflows using modern C\# and .NET.
* **Shape system architecture:** Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high\-throughput distributed systems.
* **Turn requirements into reality:** Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
* **Elevate the team:** Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
* **Own production health:** Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

 **Qualifications** **Who you are:**


You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

* **Backend depth:** 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in **C\# and modern .NET**.
* **Distributed systems:** Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event\-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
* **Data fluency:** Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
* **Observability \& troubleshooting:** Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
* **Pragmatic tooling:** Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
* **Clear communication:** Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade\-offs to both engineering peers and non\-technical partners.
* **Bonus points:** Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

 **Please note:** you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

 **Additional Information** **Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:**

  

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1\) b GDPR / Section 26 (1\) sentence 1 BDSG.


The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.


You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above\-mentioned postal address.


Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

Slutdatum: 2027\-12\-31, med option till förlängning  

Omfattning: 100%  

Plats: Stockholm / hybrid 3\-4 dagar på plats

### **Uppdragsbeskrivning**


Vi söker en senior fullstackutvecklare med stark DevOps\-profil som kan ta ett helhetsansvar genom hela utvecklingskedjan. Rollen kombinerar mjukvaruutveckling med teknisk styrning, integrationsarbete, miljöhantering och driftsättning.


Du kommer att bidra till utvecklingen av moderna webbapplikationer och kringliggande tjänster som tillsammans utgör en ny digital förmåga inom verksamheten. Uppdraget innebär nära samarbete med flera utvecklingsteam och verksamhetsintressenter, där du förväntas kunna omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar.


En viktig del av rollen är att bidra till tekniska vägval, kvalitetssäkring och arbetssätt samt att fungera som en teknisk länk mellan utveckling och övriga delar av organisationen.

### **Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:**

* Utveckla och vidareutveckla webbapplikationer med tyngdpunkt på React/TypeScript och .NET/C\#.
* Ansvara för teknisk konfiguration och förvaltning av on\-premise\-miljöer samt containerbaserade plattformar.

Join either **Data Discovery \& Experience** or **API Platform** , two teams within API \& Data Products Solutions.

**About the role**

You will help shape AI\-powered experiences by enabling AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products to create value for developers, employees, partners, and customers.

  

  

Working hands\-on with modern AI technologies, agent frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities, you will build scalable solutions that enable teams across If to discover, access, and use digital capabilities more effectively.

* Help ensure secure access using open standards.

**We offer**

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  

  

* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace

* Great insurance benefits

The **Data Discovery \& Experience** team works closely with business and technical stakeholders to improve how APIs and Data are discovered, understood, and used as Products across If.

  

  

The **API Platform** team focuses on building and evolving common platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient API consumption and integration across If and with external partners.


Both teams use agile ways of working and collaborate closely with stakeholders across business and technology domains.

  

  

This position is also a part of a larger agile Tribe responsible for providing common API and IAM capabilities that enable If's business to grow in a secure, scalable, and compliant manner. We support both internal teams and external partners through technology, products, processes, training, and governance.

  

  

**Who are you?**

You are curious, innovative, and motivated by making hard things look easy.

  

  

You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset and are excited about creating experiences that are useful, intuitive, and valuable to users.

  

  

You are comfortable navigating uncertainty, learning quickly, and working in a field that is evolving.

  

  

You see AI not as a standalone technology, but as a capability that becomes powerful when combined with data, business processes, and great user experiences.

  

  

You are passionate about agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and exploring new technologies.

  

  

You have the ability to make complex technical concepts understandable and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.  

  



You also have:

Experience from one or more of the following areas is considered a strong advantage:

**Work location:** Bergshamra, Stockholm

For more information, please contact Daniel Sahlin, Head of API and Data Product Solutions, \+46 (0\) 771 43 00 00

  

  

Final candidates will undergo a background check before employment.

  

  

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Ingestion Platform)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds organisational readiness and military training management software for clients in over 70 countries. Our flagship product, Exonaut, is used by NATO and allied forces to plan, run and evaluate exercises in real time. Our consultants and engineers work alongside armed forces across the UK, Europe, North America and beyond to deliver training and exercise management solutions.

**What we're building**


We're building the data ingestion platform behind large\-scale training exercises: a service that takes traffic from simulation federations, unmanned\-system sensor networks and real\-world sensor feeds, and turns it into one coherent stream that subscribing systems can act on. The bet is that these streams should be interpreted and mapped to an internal Ontology rather than re\-interpreted by every product that needs it. So the hard part is as much modelling as engineering — deciding what those bytes actually mean, and then holding that meaning stable as the number of sources and consumers grows. The platform is greenfield, and you'll have real influence over its shape.

**How we build**


Modern Java. The principles are conservative on purpose: boring technology, simplicity over cleverness, in\-process over distributed, shared\-nothing over shared state, domain wrapped by ports and adapters. Redundancy is an architectural property, not an operational afterthought. Designs are argued from the problem, not from what a framework happens to make easy. Proposals go through RFCs; decisions are recorded in ADRs.


Two constraints shape most of what we do. Everything the platform produces must be traceable back to the raw feed and the exact configuration that produced it — a customer has to be able to replay an exercise and defend the result. And it has to run where exercises actually run: constrained hardware, intermittent connectivity, air\-gapped sites, limited patch windows, secure by design and observability good enough for an operator in the field with no one to call.

**You**


Substantial engineering experience, opinionated about design, and comfortable arguing a position in writing. Sound judgement on reliability, security, performance, operations and cost is mandatory. Familiarity with simulation or sensor standards, IoT, geospatial mathematics or high\-throughput ingestion is a real advantage — the domain is learnable, the principles less so. We'd also rather hear about how you simplified a distributed system rather than the one you built using multiple services.


The engineering team is small, but what we are building sits at the centre of the portfolio and draws the people who know this domain best — some of the strongest simulation and modelling expertise anywhere in the field is in this building, and closely engaged in what we're building. The bar is high. Your designs will be challenged, and you'll be expected to challenge back — including on scope, since most of the pressure on a platform like this comes as reasonable\-sounding requests for one more special case.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Deterrence works only when a capability is real, and a capability is only real once it has been trained and tested under conditions close to the ones it would face. This is about making sure the organisations that would hold the line are ready.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript, Python or Go).
* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why Join 4C Strategies**


If you're happiest when the path isn't drawn yet, this is a rare chance to own hard, open problems on a large, multi\-year programme — real scale, real production systems, and the freedom to shape how they're built — with a collaborative team to figure the hard parts out alongside you. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and military specialists, with the individual\-contributor track valued as highly as management, so you can grow without leaving the code behind.


The work matters: what you build helps armed forces, public safety and resilience organisations train, prepare, and respond. If you want senior\-level ownership on systems that are used in earnest — not a backlog ticket factory — this is that role.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Solution Architects work closely with the various ESB business areas from Retail to Networks, Digital Accelerator, Digital Factory and Project Delivery ensuring a consistent \& best practice approach to architecture is applied across ESB and all its business units in order to enable ESB’s strategic ambition in a cost effective and responsive way.
  

  

As part of the ITD organisation, our Solution Architects are primarily involved in the selection and implementation of Digital \& IT solutions to meet business requirements both now and into the future. Solution Architects demonstrate a wide breadth of utility industry knowledge and IT architecture capability by understanding the impact of change on the full enterprise solution. They are responsible for ensuring the quality, integrity and supportability of all change, be that large projects, products or smaller changes.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Software Engineer
Overview  

  

We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.  

  

Our team within Mastercard – Services within Mastercard:  

  

The Data \& Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting\-edge services that are used by some of the world's largest organizations to make multi\-million dollar decisions and grow their businesses. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end\-to\-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business Test \& Learn experimentation, and data\-driven information and risk management services.  

  

Advance Analytics Program:  

  

Within the D\&S Technology Team, the Advance Analytics program is a program that is comprised of a rich set of products that provide accurate perspectives on Credit Risk, Portfolio Optimization, and Ad Insights. Currently, we are enhancing our customer experience with new user interfaces, moving to API\-based data publishing to allow for seamless integration in other Mastercard products and externally, utilizing new data sets and algorithms to further analytic capabilities, and generating scalable big data processes.  

We are looking for an innovative software engineering manager who will lead the team responsible for the design and build of a full stack web application and data pipelines, and thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment. This individual will partner closely with other areas of the business to build and enhance solutions that drive value for our customers.  

Engineers work in small, flexible teams. Every team member contributes to designing, building, and testing features. The range of work you will encounter varies from building intuitive, responsive UIs to designing backend data models, architecting data flows, and beyond. There are no rigid organizational structures, and each team uses processes that work best for its members and projects.  

  

Here are a few examples of products in our space:  

  

* Portfolio Optimizer (PO) is a solution that leverages Mastercard’s data assets and analytics to allow issuers to identify and increase revenue opportunities within their credit and debit portfolios.

  

* Audiences uses anonymized and aggregated transaction insights to offer targeting segments that have high likelihood to make purchases within a category to allow for more effective campaign planning and activation.

  

* Credit Risk products are a new suite of APIs and tooling to provide lenders real\-time access to KPIs and insights serving thousands of clients to make smarter risk decisions using Mastercard data.

  

Role  

  

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:  

  

* Participate in scoping, design and implementation of complex features.
* Delivery First time right scalable solution to push the boundaries of analytics applications.
* Design and implement intuitive, responsive UIs that allow issuers/acquirer's/fintech's to better understand data and analytics.
* Build and maintain analytics and data models to enable performant and scalable products.
* Ensure a high\-quality code base by writing and reviewing performant, well\-tested code.
* Mentor junior software engineers and teammates.
* Drive innovative improvements to team development processes.
* Partner with Product Managers and Customer Experience Designers to develop a deep understanding of users and use cases and apply that knowledge to scoping and building new modules and features.
* Collaborate across teams with exceptional peers who are passionate about what they do.

  

All about you / Ideal Candidate Qualifications  

  

* 8\+ years of full stack engineering experience in an agile production environment.
* Experience in design and implementation of complex features in full\-stack applications.


\- Experience working with cross regional Product \- Tech Team's.  

* Strong technologist eager to learn new technologies and frameworks.
* Proficiency with Java , Spring Boot , JPA , React, Redux, Typescript,
* Good to have .NET/C\# and Python.
* Solid experience with RESTful APIs and JSON/SOAP based API.
* Experience with SQL, Multi\-threading, Message Queuing \& Distributed Systems.
* Experience with Design Patterns.
* Expertise in Nunit/Junit or other automated unit testing frameworks.


Knowledge of Splunk or other alerting and monitoring solutions.  

* Fluent in the use of Git, Jenkins.
* Knowledge of cloud native development such as cloud foundry, AWS, etc.
* Customer\-centric development approach.
* Passion for analytical / quantitative problem solving.
* Ability to identify and implement improvements to team development processes.
* Strong collaboration skills with experience collaborating across many people, roles, and geographies.
* Motivation, creativity, self\-direction, and desire to thrive on small project teams.
* Superior academic record with a degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The world needs a sustainable energy future. Achieving net‑zero emissions is a tremendous challenge, and subsea technology has a critical and exciting role to play. That’s why we at OneSubsea need pioneers and visionaries. Problem‑solvers and collaborators. Curious minds and innovators. Experts and apprentices who care, work together, and drive us forward. OneSubsea is a world‑leading provider of subsea technology, enabling efficient utilization of energy resources and accelerating the transition to a more sustainable future.


We are now looking for an **Mechanical Engineer** to join our LifeCycle Management department at Askøy\*\*, Horsøy\*\*.


Our LifeCycle Management team lead the repair, refurbishment, and testing of subsea pumps and compressors. We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer with a strong technical interest in rotating equipment and problem\-solving.


In this role, you will lead repair projects, conduct technical assessments and root cause investigations, and work closely with customers, workshop personnel, and engineering teams to deliver safe and reliable solutions.


#### **In this role, you will**


* Provide technical and engineering support for the repair and refurbishment of subsea pumps and compressors
* Act as the technical lead on assigned repair and refurbishment projects
* Develop repair scopes covering inspection, repair, assembly, testing, and qualification activities
* Support project managers and workshop personnel throughout repair execution
* Lead or support root cause analyses and technical investigations to identify corrective and preventive actions
* Review repair findings, deviations, and opportunities for equipment improvements and upgrades
* Participate in system integration testing, factory acceptance testing, and other verification activities
* Support quotation and tender activities through technical assessments and scope discussions
* Collaborate with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders across global locations
* Champion a strong HSE and quality culture in everything you do

#### **We are looking for someone who**


* Wants to work with industry\-leading technology and contribute to a more sustainable energy future
* Holds a BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, Maritime Technology, or a related technical discipline
* Has at least 2 years of experience with rotating equipment such as pumps, compressors, or similar systems
* Has a strong technical interest and enjoys troubleshooting, technical investigations, and problem solving
* Has experience with repair, maintenance, lifecycle services, or oil and gas operations
* Has experience with Creo or similar CAD software is considered an advantage
* Is proactive, self\-driven, and brings positive energy to the team
* Communicates effectively with customers, vendors, and colleagues across disciplines
* Thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment

#### **With us, you will experience**


* Colleagues who like to create solutions and achieve success together, collaborating with highly qualified engineers working with leading energy companies worldwide
* A workday where you can influence the outcome of development and technical solutions, contributing to impactful engineering decisions
* Being part of an international group with clear ambitions that appreciate initiative and innovation, in an international work environment that values initiative and innovation
* Varied tasks across customers, projects, and technologies, giving you a dynamic and challenging everyday life
* Good development opportunities where you can grow in several directions within the company, with strong development opportunities within OneSubsea and SLB
* Competitive conditions and a work environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
* Flexible working arrangements, including home\-office opportunities
* Modern facilities at Horsøy, including parking, in\-house gym, and cafeteria

#### **Interested?**


To be considered for this position, please attach the following documents with your application:


* CV in English or Norwegian
* Transcripts of Records (or other documents detailing your education, subjects, and grades)

If this sounds exciting, we hope you will apply!


Applications missing this documentation will not be considered.


#### **Diversity and Inclusion**


At OneSubsea, we see our diverse workforce as a great advantage.


We promote an inclusive work environment where equal opportunities, diversity, and inclusion are key to our success.


We believe that diversity enriches us, attracts talent, and makes working life more exciting.


Therefore, we encourage all candidates to apply regardless of background, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, gender, ethnicity, disability, or age.

SLB, OneSubsea Processing, Aker Solutions, and Subsea7 have come together to create the world's leading subsea technology and solutions provider.

The joint venture brings together deep reservoir domain expertise, broad front\-end and system design knowledge.


We provide an extensive field\-proven subsea production and processing technology portfolio, world\-class manufacturing scale and capacity, and unique pore\-to\-process integration capabilities.

**Vil du utvikle produktet som gir teknikere bedre oversikt, raskere feilsøking og tryggere drift av avansert boreutstyr?**
===========================================================================================================================


**Om stillingen**


Maskin Control utvikler software og kontrollsystemer for boreutstyr, roboter og automatiserte prosesser. Vi søker nå en erfaren softwareingeniør som vil bidra til videreutviklingen av MCDT \- Machine Control Diagnostic Tool, et produkt som kobler sammen kontrollsystemer, instrumentering, visualisering og operativ feilsøking.


MCDT gir riggelektroteknikere og hydraulikere sanntidsinnsikt i maskiner og komponenter. Produktet samler blant annet alarmer, I/O\-data, trendkurver, P\&ID\-visning, komponentinformasjon, 3D\-visualisering, kalibrering og veiledet diagnostikk i én helhetlig løsning. Målet er å gjøre det enklere å forstå hva som skjer, finne rotårsaken og gjennomføre riktige tiltak.


Som Software Engineer blir du en sentral del av et tverrfaglig produktmiljø. Du vil arbeide med videreutvikling av eksisterende moduler og nye funksjoner, og følge løsningene fra behov og design via implementasjon og testing til installasjon og bruk på boreutstyr.


**Arbeidsoppgaver**


* Videreutvikling av MCDT\-plattformen og produktets brukergrensesnitt basert på WinCC OA fra Siemens
* Utvikling av funksjonalitet for sanntidsdata, I/O\-visning, alarmer og trendanalyse
* Arbeid med visualisering av elektriske og hydrauliske P\&ID\-er med levende prosessdata
* Utvikling av diagnostikk\- og veiledningsfunksjoner som hjelper brukeren å finne rotårsaker
* Integrasjon mot PLS\-er, kontrollsystemer, instrumentering, sensorer og maskindata
* Arbeid med komponentinformasjon, datasheets, 3D\-visning og kobling mellom fysisk utstyr og digital modell
* Utvikling og testing av kalibrerings\- og servicefunksjoner for autoriserte brukere
* Testing i simulator, testmiljø og på fysisk boreutstyr, samt FAT og idriftsettelse
* Teknisk dokumentasjon, feilsøking og samarbeid med prosjekt\-, service\- og automasjonsmiljøer

**Vi ser etter deg som har**


* Flere års erfaring med softwareutvikling av industrielle, tekniske eller produktnære løsninger
* Relevant høyere utdanning innen software, datateknologi, automasjon, kybernetikk, mekatronikk eller tilsvarende erfaring
* God forståelse av sanntidsdata, kontrollsystemer, instrumentering eller industriell automasjon
* Erfaring med å utvikle robuste brukergrensesnitt for komplekse tekniske systemer
* Evne til å omsette behov fra teknikere og operatører til intuitive og driftssikre løsninger
* Strukturert og analytisk arbeidsform, med interesse for feilsøking og rotårsaksanalyse
* Gode norsk\- og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

**Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med**


* C\#, C\+\+, Python eller tilsvarende programmeringsspråk
* WinCC OA fra Siemens og utvikling av HMI/SCADA\-løsninger
* PLS\- og kontrollsystemer, for eksempel Siemens TIA Portal
* OPC UA, Profinet, TCP/IP eller andre industrielle kommunikasjonsprotokoller
* Trenddata, alarmhåndtering, logging og visualisering av prosessverdier
* P\&ID, elektriske/hydrauliske skjemaer, instrumentering eller maskindiagnostikk
* 3D\-modeller, simulering eller digital representasjon av fysisk utstyr
* Erfaring fra drilling, offshore, tungt utstyr eller andre krevende industrielle miljøer

**Hvorfor NOV?**


Hos NOV får du jobbe med et produkt som brukes til å gjøre komplekse maskiner enklere å forstå og vedlikeholde. Du blir del av et sterkt fagmiljø i Maskin Control, der softwareutviklere, automasjonsingeniører, robotprogrammerere og fageksperter samarbeider tett om løsninger som skal fungere i krevende operasjoner over hele verden.


Du får:


* Arbeide med et produkt i skjæringspunktet mellom software, automasjon og boreutstyr
* Mulighet til å påvirke produktarkitektur, brukeropplevelse og videre funksjonalitet
* Teknisk krevende oppgaver med tydelig verdi for drift, vedlikehold og sikkerhet
* Et tverrfaglig miljø med høy grad av samarbeid og faglig sparring
* Mulighet til å følge løsningen fra utvikling til bruk på virkelig utstyr
* Gode utviklings\- og karrieremuligheter samt konkurransedyktige betingelser

**Mangfold og inkludering**


Vi ønsker å fremme mangfold og like muligheter. Derfor oppfordrer vi alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uavhengig av kjønn, alder, kulturell bakgrunn, funksjonsevne eller livssyn.

**Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende.** Send oss din søknad dersom du ønsker å utvikle neste generasjon verktøy for diagnostikk, service og kontroll av boreutstyr.

**Arbeidsoppgaver**

* Videreutvikling av MCDT\-plattformen og produktets brukergrensesnitt basert på WinCC OA fra Siemens
* Utvikling av funksjonalitet for sanntidsdata, I/O\-visning, alarmer og trendanalyse

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Make a difference with Laerdal where immersive technology transforms healthcare quality and education across the globe. With over 2,200 colleagues, join a team where collaboration and engagement are prioritized in helping save one million more lives, every year, by 2030\.

**About the role**


In the Digital Customer Platforms team at Laerdal, we shape how customers around the world discover, buy, and use products and services that help save lives. Through our global e‑commerce platform on laerdal.com, we deliver scalable, secure, and increasingly AI‑supported digital solutions across more than 25 markets.


As Engineering Manager, based in Stavanger, you will lead a great team of software engineers working on business‑critical platforms with real societal impact. You’ll balance people leadership with technical insight, creating an environment where collaboration, learning, and long‑term product sustainability come first. Your role is to help teams succeed—today and over time—while continuously improving how we build and evolve our digital solutions.


Our technology landscape is modern and evolving, with C\#/.NET on Azure at the core and React and Vue.js on the frontend. Experience with our stack is valuable, but we especially welcome leaders with strong fundamentals in cloud technologies, APIs, and product‑focused software development, who are curious about how AI can be applied responsibly and meaningfully.

**Some of what you will be doing**

* Lead and support a team of engineers by setting clear direction, building trust, and encouraging growth
* Shape technical choices with an eye on quality, sustainability, security, and long‑term platform health
* Partner closely with Product and Design to turn ideas into well‑prioritized, valuable customer solutions
* Strengthen ways of working across the team—from planning and delivery to testing and continuous improvement
* Promote good engineering practices and thoughtful use of emerging technologies, including AI
* Help create a positive, inclusive team culture where diverse perspectives are valued

**Who we think will thrive here**


You are a leader who enjoys enabling others and believes strong teams build the best products. You bring technical credibility, curiosity, and empathy to your work, and you’re motivated by creating durable solutions rather than quick fixes. Whether you already lead teams or are ready to take the next step into engineering leadership, you care deeply about collaboration, quality, and impact.  

Experience that will support your success includes:

* A solid background in software development and modern engineering practices and relevant higher education
* Experience leading, mentoring, or guiding engineers in a product‑focused environment
* Comfort working with cloud‑based systems; Azure experience is a plus
* Experience from agile, empowered, cross‑functional teams
* A leadership style that communicates clearly, listens actively, and builds engagement
* Takes initiatives and move ideas into action
* Approaches challenges with structured problem solving and critical thinking. .


We know strong leaders don’t all look the same—if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

**What we offer**


At Laerdal, you will get the opportunity to learn, develop, and innovate and you will be a part of an international working environment where the possibility to make an impact is endless.

* An interesting, impactful and important job contributing to our mission
* Great opportunities for growth and personal development
* A multicultural office environment and collaboration with colleagues located around the world
* A creative, diverse, and inclusive organization
* A job in a company driving forward\-thinking technology
* Competitive salary, pension scheme, and insurance
* An extensive welfare program with company benefits such as discounted public transport, indoor bicycle garage, and workshop, wardrobe with towel service, social and sports groups, company cabins, and more


Our colleagues are from all over the world, and we pride ourselves on being an international company. We offer a competitive relocation package if you will be relocating from another country to Norway.


Curious to know more? Please contact Katrine Holdhus; katrine.holdhus@laerdal.com for questions regarding this vacancy.


Don’t wait until the deadline (14 October) to apply. We review applications as they come in and may begin interviews before the closing date.

*Please note that we use Semac background checks in our recruitment process.*

**Job Description**
-------------------


We are continuously looking for QA Engineers who can handle manual testing and test automation, to join our Tampere office and work with our industrial customers.


We operate in a hybrid working model, with approximately three days per week either at the customer site or at an Etteplan office.


**Key responsibilities**


* Define test cases based on end\-customer requirements
* Support project delivery and implementation activities
* Ensure proper documentation, reporting, and change management processes

* Proactive and self\-driven working style, with the ability to work independently while also building strong relationships with various stakeholders
* Working as a part of scrum team

**We also appreciate**

* Experience with test automation and CI/CD pipeline management
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language commonly used in automation or testing environments, such as Python or C\#

* Familiarity with Azure DevOps

* Opportunity to work with leading industrial customers
* A key role in a large\-scale software development project
* Excellent opportunities for professional growth and career development

The salary range is quite wide, reflecting our openness to both earlier‑career and more experienced professionals. What matters most to us is finding the right competencies and fit, and aligning the role and compensation to match.

-----------------------


* Occupational health services and insurance fund
* Lunch, sport and culture benefit
* Events and activities
* Talent Referral bonus
* Benefit and discount program for employees and their families
* Phone benefit

  
**About the company**

As a technology service company, we bring people and technology together to change things for the better. Explore our openings and become part of a culture which believes in collaboration, creativity, and innovation. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location:** Helsinki, Finland (Hybrid)

**Department:** Software development

**Type:** Full\-time

**Application deadline:** October 13, 2026

 **Are you ready to build the software that helps medical professionals harness the power of AI? Aiforia is transforming the world of tissue diagnostics and medical image analysis. We equip pathologists and scientists with deep learning AI to improve efficiency and consistency across clinical histopathology of cancer.**

**Our mission is to provide high\-quality, AI\-assisted solutions that enable personalized and democratized care for patients. To help us achieve this, we are looking for a driven Software Engineer to build and improve the products that bring our AI to clinical and research users.**

### **Role and responsibilities**


As a core member of our engineering team, you will work across the full stack, from back\-end services to the web applications our customers use every day. You will help expand Aiforia's platform and keep our existing products robust and reliable.

**Your key tasks will include:**

* Architecture and design: Design scalable, robust solutions across the stack, from back\-end services and APIs to user\-facing web features.
* Software implementation: Develop, write, and optimize production\-level code across the stack.
* AI tooling and context: Write and maintain the specifications, repository context, and prompts that make AI workflows possible.
* Quality assurance: Ensure high standards of code quality and reliability through code reviews, unit tests, and validation protocols.
* Technical documentation: Write and maintain clear, accurate technical documentation to support development, regulatory compliance, and cross\-team collaboration.
* Product maintenance: Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain existing products to ensure seamless performance for our users in clinical and research settings.

### **Who we are looking for**

The ideal candidate is a versatila engineer who is comfortable moving between back\-end front\-end work. You write clean dove, care about the end user, and thrive in a collaborative, mission\-driven environment.
  

  

**Requirements:**

* Educational background: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Experience: 3\+ years of relevant industry experience in full\-stack or software engineering.
* Technical skills: Strong programming skills and hands\-on experience building and deploying web applications and back\-end services in production.
* Communication: Excellent teamwork and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.
* AI\-assisted development: Daily hands\-on use of AI coding tools in production work. You can explain the role of agents and context in the development workflow, and how you verify the result.

**What gives you an edge:**

* Experience and knowledge of image analysis and AI model building, and the workflows associated with them, including data management, verification metrics, and validation.
* Experience building and evolving an AI harness: the infrastructure around the development process that lets agents operate as independent actors across the delivery lifecycle.
* Experience improving how a team adopts AI coding tools: shared context, execution loops, and safety boundaries.
* Experience with our core stack: C\#/.NET.
* Experience with modern front\-end frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, TypeScript).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, databases, and cloud computing platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
* Previous experience working with medical devices, healthcare data, or within regulated environments (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA).

### **What we offer**

* Innovation: A chance to work at the forefront of medical AI technologies and make a real impact on patient care.
* Culture: Join a supportive, enthusiastic, and multidisciplinary team of experts who are passionate about what they do.
* Growth: Real opportunities for professional and career development in one of the fastest\-growing sectors of health tech.

### **Location**


Helsinki, Finland.


We offer a hybrid work model that provides flexibility for your daily life. However, we hope that you will work primarily from our office during the initial stage of your employment. This ensures you receive the best possible support, a smooth onboarding experience, and the opportunity to truly get to know your team from day one.


Please note: We are unable to sponsor visas for this position.

### **How to apply**


Are you the person we are looking for? Please, send your application by October 13, 2026 through careers.aiforia.com.

* For data privacy reasons, we only accept applications submitted via the portal.
* Please include a portfolio or work samples showcasing your design process and past projects.
* Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis prior to the deadline, so please submit yours as soon as possible.


Before you apply: Please read Aiforia's Privacy Policy for Job Applicants before submitting your application.


Aiforia is committed to creating an environment of inclusivity in which all voices and individuals are heard. We strive toward this by providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

**Aiforia Create:** **https://www.aiforia.com/aiforia\-create**

Rakennat ja toimitat kyberturvallista ja käyntivarmaa IT\-palvelua ja toimit luotettavana kumppanina eri sidosryhmille. * Elinvoimainen ja osallistava työympäristö, jossa ideoillasi on merkitystä
* Yrityskulttuurin, joka arvostaa vastuullisuutta, oma\-aloitteisuutta ja itsenäisyyttä.

* Mahdollisuuden osittaiseen etätyöhön, joka sovitaan erikseen.

* Suunnittele, kehitä ja toteuta tuotannon sovelluskehitystä prosessiparannusten saavuttamiseksi
* Sovellusten elinkaaren hallinta omalla vastuualueellasi
* Kyberturvallisuuden parannukset sovelluskehityksen näkökulmasta
* Tuki\- ja kehitystoimet sovitun palvelutason mukaisesti tai ylläpito\- tai projektisuunnitelmissa määritellyllä tavalla
* Tunnistat liiketoiminnan tarpeet ja mahdollisuudet uusiin tehokkaisiin ratkaisuihin
* Vastuunotto korkea laadun varmistamiseksi ja ylläpitämiseksi kaikilla päivittäisen työn osa\-alueilla, esimerkiksi ylläpitodokumentaatiom pitäminen ajan tasalla
* Työt vastuualueesi IT\-projekteissa osana projektitiimiä
* Loppukäyttäjätuki mukaan lukien päivystystyö tarvittaessa

  

**Keskeiset vaatimukset**
  

* Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. AMK tai yliopisto tietojenkäsittelyn tai tietotekniikan alalta)
* Sujuva suomen ja englannin taito (sekä kirjallinen että suullinen)
* Osaaminen eri kehityskielissä (esim .NET, Microsoft\-teknologiat, type script, Java, JavaScript, Python, C/C\+\+) sekä tuotekehitystyökaluissa versionhallintaa (esim. Git). Kehitystyökalut (esim. Visual Studio code)
* Hyvät perustaidot palvelinkäyttöjärjestelmistä ja tietokannoista (esim. Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL)
* Hyvät perustaidot pilviteknologioista (Azure).
* Hyvät ongelmanratkaisu\-, yhteistyö\- ja viestintätaidot
* Tinkimätön asenne työturvallisuuteen

* Kokemusta kaivos\- ja tehdasympäristöstä ja sitä tukevista IT\-ratkaisuista
* Kokemusta työskentelystä osana kehittyvää tiimiä

Jos uskot sopivasi tehtävään, lähetä hakemuksesi 25\.10\.2026 mennessä.

jobs.title: Release Train Architect - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Jyväskylä, Finland


* Full\-time
* Application and Product Development
* Hybrid
* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

**About us**


Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

  

**About the role**


We are now looking for **a Release Train Architect (RTA)** to work with **Tieto Caretech** healthcare products where you will contribute to simplifying everyday life for patients, professionals and customers. In the architect role you will be ensuring that the architectural and technical decisions taken are aligned with Lifecare strategy, data security and set of requirements.

 **In this role you will**

* Design, implement, and verify software architecture with a focus on the bigger picture and product architecture.
* Utilize advanced .NET concepts, design patterns, and SOLID design principles to develop robust software solutions.
* Lead and mentor teams in web development using WebApi, Angular, HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SPA, and NgRx/Redux.
* Apply hands\-on experience in the .Net Stack and other frameworks to deliver full\-stack solutions.
* Implement SOA, IOC, REST API, Microservices, and Event\-driven architecture.

 **We are looking for someone with**

* 10\+ years of experience in the software industry.
* Proficiency in **both** **English** and **Finnish** languages.

Extensive knowledge of web technologies and patterns.  
* 

**It would be beneficial if you also have**

* Experience with cloud development and deployment, preferably in Azure.
* Understanding of Domain Driven Development and Test\-Driven Development.
* Familiarity with C\#, Angular, C\+\+, RabbitMQ, XML, WCF, WPF, IIS/Windows services, SOAP.
* Knowledge of DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Deployment.
* Awareness of cross\-browser compatibility and web standards.
* Understanding of OpenEHR.
* Experience in the healthcare domain.
* Familiarity with integration standards like FHIR, HL7\.

  

As a person we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrate responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end to end development process you will continuously both learn from and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new cutting\-edge technologies is something you strive to do.

  

**AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**


With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work\-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host an annual ‘Keep Learning Week’, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

  

**Could you be our new colleague?**  

  

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Teijo Mustonen \[teijo.mustonen@tieto.com]

  

Additional Information  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.  

Diversity, equity and inclusion \| Sustainability \| Tieto

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud \| Tieto Blog

  
We provide customers across different industries with mission\-critical solutions through our specialized software businesses Tieto Caretech, Tieto Banktech and Tieto Indtech as well as Tieto Tech Consulting business.


Our around 14 000 talented vertical software, design, cloud and AI experts are dedicated to empowering our customers to succeed and innovate with latest technology.


Tieto’s annual revenue is approximately EUR 2 billion. The company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

jobs.title: People and Project Manager - for AI-assisted diagnostic medical software
jobs.description:
In 3Shape we work to improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients by providing innovative scanners and advanced software, tied together in collaborative workflows for the global community of dental professionals worldwide. We are using AI and machine learning methods for analyzing large amounts of medical (dentistry) data – pushing a field which traditionally has looked at 2D images towards 3D scan data.

**The product**


TRIOS Dx offers AI\-assisted dental diagnostic aid tools for monitoring oral health conditions and assessing changes in teeth and gingiva. By analyzing a 3D scan TRIOS Dx assists in diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque.


TRIOS Dx was made public and available to end users last year. We are now in a phase where we listen to market feedback and improve the product. We also plan to add new and existing functionality to it over the next many years.

**The position**


We are looking for a skilled People \& Project Manager for the AI team currently responsible for the AI’s diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque. You will be driving end\-to\-end delivery of innovative AI solutions and will during this play a key role in ensuring we use state\-of\-the\-art AI solutions, have the right data for AI development, and have thorough and efficient documentation required to get AP approved for use in a Medical Device software. Your main tasks include:

* Build, coach, and develop the team, cultivating an environment where people can do the best work of their lives.
* Lead your team through the full product lifecycle \- from ideation and development to deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on customer feedback.
* Ensure the team have clear ownership of domains, responsibilities, and deliverables.


You will be collaborating with various professionals such as application developers, AI developers, QA, RA, Product Management, and a Clinical Research team of dental professionals.

**Your profile**


We are looking for candidates with a good understanding of the AI and AI development. You may have experience from related positions, and you have a relevant education.

* Master’s degree or a PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering or a related field
* 2\+ years of leadership experience managing and growing engineering teams.
* Proven experience with Machine Learning (e.g. deep neural networks, supervised and unsupervised learning), preferably within image processing or processing of 3D data
* Solid software development skills, preferably in Python and C\#
* Mindset for quality, flexibility, creativity, emerging technologies


In our search for a new colleague, we always look for people with a cross\-disciplinary and open mindset. Through cooperation with program managers, project managers, developers, testers, and Regulatory Affair specialists; you will get an in\-depth understanding of all aspects of medical software development and use this to enable further growth and success.

**Get in touch now!**


Please do not hesitate to apply as soon for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest\-growing high\-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously. The deadline for application is **10\. October**. We look forward to hearing from you.


We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**About us**


3Shape started with a simple idea \- to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000\+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award\-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday \#lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Senior .NET & OutSystems Developer til langsigtet offentlig IT-løsning [fm374]
jobs.description:
SKM Group søger en erfaren udvikler med kompetencer inden for både **.NET og OutSystems** til et langsigtet samarbejde med en større dansk offentlig organisation.

Du kommer til at arbejde i et systemlandskab, der består af både traditionelle Microsoft\-baserede løsninger og applikationer udviklet på OutSystems\-platformen.

Rollen kombinerer vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af eksisterende systemer med integrationer, modernisering og nyudvikling.

**Dine opgaver**

**Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:**

* vedligeholdelse, fejlsøgning og videreudvikling af **OutSystems\-applikationer**
* udvikling og videreudvikling i **C\# / .NET**
* integration mellem OutSystems, .NET\-systemer, databaser og eksterne systemer
* udvikling og fejlsøgning af API'er og integrationer
* **SQL Server**, datamodeller, stored procedures, views, functions, triggers og SQL\-jobs
* analyse og fejlsøgning på tværs af applikations\-, database\- og integrationslag
* refaktorering og modernisering af eksisterende løsninger
* IIS, Windows Services og relaterede middlewarekomponenter
* code review samt unit\-, integrations\-, system\- og regressionstest
* CI/CD, release og deployment
* teknisk analyse og løsningsdesign
* teknisk dokumentation og vidensoverdragelse
* tæt samarbejde med kundens udviklere, Product Owners, drift og øvrige leverandører

**Vi søger dig, der**

* har minimum 5 **års relevant erfaring med .NET/C\#**
* har professionel erfaring med udvikling og vedligeholdelse i **OutSystems**
* har god erfaring med **SQL Server**
* kan analysere og fejlfinde komplekse eksisterende løsninger
* har erfaring med API'er og systemintegration
* er vant til at arbejde med både udvikling og produktionsnære problemstillinger
* har forståelse for test, deployment og CI/CD
* arbejder selvstændigt og proaktivt
* kan kommunikere professionelt **på dansk**, både mundtligt og skriftligt
* kan udarbejde teknisk dokumentation på dansk
* bor i Danmark eller ønsker at arbejde fast i Danmark og kan møde fysisk hos kunden i Glostrup efter behov

**Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har**

* **OutSystems\-certificering**
* minimum 3 års konkret erfaring med fejlsøgning, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af OutSystems\-løsninger
* erfaring med integration mellem OutSystems og eksterne API'er/databaser
* SSIS
* IIS og Windows Server
* Azure DevOps / Azure Pipelines
* JIRA og Confluence
* erfaring fra større enterprise\- eller offentlige IT\-miljøer
* erfaring med legacy\-modernisering

**Om SKM Group**

SKM Group er et europæisk softwareudviklingsfirma med mere end 18 års erfaring inden for custom software development, modernisering af eksisterende systemer samt AI og data.

Vi arbejder langsigtet med vores kunder og bygger stabile udviklingsteams omkring komplekse forretningskritiske systemer.

Til denne rolle opbygger vi et **lokalt dansk team**, som samtidig bliver en del af SKM Groups internationale udviklingsorganisation.

Jobtype: Fuldtid

Løn: 450,00kr. \- 800,00kr. pr. time

Forventet timeantal: 40\.0 pr. uge

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (API for Cloud Networking)
jobs.description:
**Do you want to create new networking products and craft clean APIs that enable customers to better use the Akamai Cloud?**

**Are you a software engineering enthusiast who loves solving complex problems?**

**Join our Cloud Networking Products team!**

Akamai Cloud is the world's most distributed cloud platform. Our customers range from frontier AI companies to scale\-ups and established market leaders.We are looking for a new colleague to join our API team in the Cloud Networking Products division.


**Partner with the best**

Join us in shaping the next generation of cloud computing. This role provides an opportunity to make a significant impact on Akamai's growing cloud offerings. You must have a passion to get things done quickly and get them done right.


As a Software Engineer Senior, you will be responsible for:


* Helping build out cloud platform functionality that sets up, manages, and protects networking in the Akamai Cloud.
* Designing and implementing clean, robust and performant REST APIs used by customers and internal teams.
* Developing and maintaining internal libraries and microservices used by various teams in Akamai.
* Designing, implementing, reviewing, documenting, and testing high quality Python code in close collaboration with your team.
* Reviewing and contributing to architectural and design documents authored by other teams.

**Do what you love**

To be successful in this role you will:


* Have background with mainstream programming languages, such as Python, Java, C\#, or Go.
* Have solid skills in writing, testing and understanding complex software.
* Have experience in designing and implementing REST APIs.
* Be experienced in technical design, product specifications reviews, projects and backlog planning.
* Be able to work productively with team members to identify and resolve issues in a collaborative manner.
* Have good communication skills, and experience in communicating with leadership and non\-developer stakeholders.
* Be experienced in mentoring other developers.

Some of the tools and frameworks we use are Python, docker, pytest, MySQL, SQLAlchemy, Flask, Prometheus and Grafana. While we don't expect you to have experience with all of them, curiosity and a willingness to learn is a must. Experience with developing microservices is a nice bonus. We are a team with a diverse background and while the majority of the team members are located in Denmark, our main working language is English.


**About us**

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
  

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
  

  

Our focus is simple:
  

**Cloud and Edge:** Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
  

**Security** : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
  

**Content Delivery** : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
  

**AI** : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.
  

  

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.


**Benefits at Akamai:** We support your health, well\-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.


**FlexBase adapts to your job's needs**

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.
  

  

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.


Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Onsite
At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.


Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


The Senior Engineer will drive Collins Aerospace’s transition toward highly automated, autonomous, and digitally connected manufacturing across multi sites under Singapore Operations . This includes robotics, machining automation, material\-handling systems, machine vision, factory systems integration. The role blends deep automation expertise, strong OT/IT integration capability to realize Collins’ Lights\-Out Manufacturing and Factory of the Future aspirations.


Roles \& Responsibilities


1\. Automation \& Robotics System Architecture


Lead design and deployment of robotics and automation systems for CNC machining, machine tending, material handling, inspection, and finishing.  

Develop process sequences, cycle\-time models, EOAT designs, and automation fixtures tailored to aerospace machining requirements.  

Integrate machine vision, sensing, and AI\-assisted inspection into robotic workflows for precision manufacturing.  

2\. Controls, Software \& Factory Systems Integration


Develop PLC/PC\-based control systems, robot programs (ABB/Fanuc/KUKA/UR), motion control logic, and HMI interfaces.  

Implement industrial communication protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, REST) to integrate automation with CNCs, sensors, MES, SCADA, IIoT platforms, and enterprise systems.  

Conduct virtual commissioning, simulation, and system validation using digital engineering tools.  

3\. Factory Systems Engineering \& OT/IT Integration


Lead end\-to\-end integration of automation with:  

CNC machining centers  

MES \& ERP  

SCADA \& historian systems  

Tool management \& traceability systems  

Quality and inspection databases  

Develop high\-availability automation networks with strong data integrity, redundancy, and cybersecurity compliance.  

Architect scalable, modular automation platforms for autonomous cells, flexible machining systems, and Seletar Factory of the Future.  

4\. Project Leadership \& Vendor Management


Define SORs, specifications, layouts, acceptance test plans, budgets, and lifecycle plans for automation initiatives.  

Lead multi\-site implementation with strong governance, risk management, and adherence to safety standards (ISO 10218, ISO 13849, IEC 61508\).  

Evaluate commercial proposals, manage suppliers, and drive cost\-effective adoption of advanced manufacturing technologies.

  

Qualifications \& Skills


Education


Bachelor’s or Master’s in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or related disciplines.  

Technical Expertise


5 \-10 years in robotics, automation, machining automation, and factory systems integration.  

Strong experience with CNC machining processes, robotic machine tending, vision systems, and aerospace precision manufacturing.  

Proficiency in controls engineering, PLC/PC programming, robot programming (ABB/Fanuc/KUKA/UR), and OT industrial networks.  

Digital \& Data Skills


Experience with MES/SCADA/IIoT platforms, OPC UA servers, MQTT, and machine connectivity frameworks.  

Proficiency in SQL, Python, and scripting for data processing, systems integration, and automated workflows.  

Experience with simulation and digital twin tools such as Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, Plant Simulation, or FlexSim.  

Software \& Application Skills


Skilled in automation\-oriented programming languages (Python, C\+\+, C\#, Java).  

Leadership \& Project Skills


5\+ years managing automation or capital projects; PMP/Prince2 certification advantageous.  

Strong competency in technology insertion, NPI automation readiness, factory redesign, and process revalidation.  

Excellent communication and stakeholder management across engineering, operations, quality, and digital technology teams.  

Additional Desired Skills


Familiarity with AS9100, APQP/PPAP, and aerospace manufacturing quality systems.  

Experience with cybersecurity for OT/automation networks.  

Strong capability in structured problem solving (6σ, DMAIC, FMEA).
